interRules.text:
Inter-song rules (plans/tv-screens.md)

- Up next is the song that plays next. AFTER THAT is the rest in queue order, as on the phone Queue page, numbered from 2.
- Downloading, processing, lyrics-pick and paused songs keep their number: dashed slot with the word, row faded. Failed songs are hidden and not counted in + N more.
- Countdown has its own setting (default 8 s, replaces splash_delay). It restarts when the Up next song changes; the list updates live. No start-now button.
- At zero: these pieces fade out (400 ms), the video fades in from black (1 s).
- Nothing ready: "Getting the first song ready." Every song paused: "Every song in the queue is paused." No countdown either way.
- Long Up next titles wrap to two lines, then cut off.
- overlay_scale leaves this layout alone. Plain black (a black 1344 x 768 placeholder). English only for now.
- Corners 16 px in; clock and address on 40% black pills.

duringRules.text:
During-song rules (plans/tv-screens.md)

- Full card for the first 15-20 s of playing time (pauses not counted), compact card in the middle, up-next card for the last 30 s of time left (seeking back takes it away). Too short for both: split evenly, no compact stage.
- Stage changes crossfade, 400 ms in 8 steps. Song end: black fades in over 1 s under the corners (music fades too on a skip); song start mirrors it.
- Pause: full card with Paused, NEXT line back; an up-next card stays. Resume crossfades to the stage before.
- Key or vocals changed after the full card: the compact card grows a settings row (both tags, the changed one in amber) and shrinks back after 4 s; each change restarts the 4 s. Nothing under the card moves out of order; it shifts down with the card.
- Nothing queued after: compact card alone. A queue change under the up-next card crossfades it.
- hide_now_playing_overlay hides the cards only. QR, clock and address stay all song. 4:3 and cinematic: no special placement.
- Cards 70% black, up-next card 75%. Lyrics Lato Bold 66, outline and shadow as today.
